{{Top|leg}}
A '''marsh-slither''' was a creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base [[DVL-181]] was located. Marsh-slithers were known to get into the landing gear of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on the base.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
